intent: Show that the monthly price of the arthritis drug Humira is higher in the United States than in six other developed countries.

requirements.question: How does the monthly Humira price in the United States compare with six other countries?

units.claim: The United States has the highest monthly Humira price at about $3,300, compared with about $895 to $1,726 in the six other countries.
accept: the United States has the tallest bar
the U.S. is the highest-priced country
the U.S. price is about $3,300 while every comparison country is below $1,800
reject: the U.S. is lower than another comparison country
monthly prices are described as annual prices
the U.S. or a comparison country is omitted
units.evidence: Seven country bars share one dollar scale; the U.S. bar is substantially taller than all the others.

optional_valid: The narration says Humera, while the chart title identifies the drug as Humira.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows because the table has no role column
